```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)

library(readxl)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(terra::any)

calc_ha_exact <- function(r) {
  if(is.null(r)) return(0)
  if(all(is.na(terra::values(r, mat=FALSE)))) return(0)
  area_raster <- r * terra::cellSize(r, unit = "ha")
  val <- terra::global(area_raster, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
  return(as.numeric(val))
}

cluster_filter_compleet <- function(masker, opp_laag, drempel_m2, dist_m, werkelijk = FALSE) {
  if (terra::global(is.na(masker), "sum")[[1]] == terra::ncell(masker)) {
    return(list(raster = masker * NA, clusters = masker * NA))
  }
  
  if (dist_m > 0) {
    r_binair <- terra::ifel(!is.na(masker) & masker > 0, 1, NA)
    r_buffered <- terra::buffer(r_binair, width = dist_m / 2)
    cl_network <- terra::patches(r_buffered, directions = 4, zeroAsNA = TRUE)
    cl_biotoop_only <- terra::mask(cl_network, masker)
  } else {
    cl_network <- terra::patches(masker, directions = 8, zeroAsNA = TRUE)
    cl_biotoop_only <- cl_network
  }
  
  if(werkelijk) {
    stats_df <- terra::zonal(opp_laag, cl_biotoop_only, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
    colnames(stats_df) <- c("ID", "Waarde")
    stats_df$Area_m2 <- stats_df$Waarde * 100 
  } else {
    f <- terra::freq(cl_biotoop_only)
    stats_df <- data.frame(ID = f$value, Waarde = f$count)
    stats_df$Area_m2 <- stats_df$Waarde * 100 
  }
  
  stats_df <- stats_df[!is.na(stats_df$ID), ]
  if(nrow(stats_df) == 0) return(list(raster = masker * NA, clusters = masker * NA))
  
  voldoet_ids <- stats_df$ID[stats_df$Area_m2 >= drempel_m2]
  if(length(voldoet_ids) == 0) return(list(raster = masker * NA, clusters = masker * NA))
  
  masker_binair <- cl_biotoop_only %in% voldoet_ids
  final_network_mask <- terra::ifel(masker_binair == 1, 1, NA)
  
  r_finaal  <- terra::mask(masker, final_network_mask)
  cl_finaal <- terra::mask(cl_biotoop_only, r_finaal) 
  
  return(list(raster = r_finaal, clusters = cl_finaal))
}

terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.8,
  tempdir = tempdir(),
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
soort <- "weidevogel"

# ZONDER KERN-EIS: We stellen 1 integrale netwerkdrempel in.
# Elk netwerk/cluster van gekoppelde biotopen moet minimaal 10 ha (of 25 ha) beslaan.
totaal_netwerk_ha <- 10   # Minimale totale oppervlakte per functioneel netwerk
koppel_afstand_m  <- 200  # Koppelafstand tussen biotoopelementen (100m buffer)
buffer_m <- 25000
message(paste0("Instellingen voor '", soort, "': Geen kernvereiste. MinOpp Netwerk = ", 
               totaal_netwerk_ha, " ha, Koppelafstand = ", koppel_afstand_m, " m"))
```

```{r}
area_shape  <- vect(here("data/input/Turnhouts_Vennegebied.shp"))
master_grid <- rast(here("data/input/Raster_Vlaanderen/Vlaanderen_MasterGrid_10m.tif"))[[1]]

df_namen_sleutel <- read_csv(here("data/input/Excel_files/BWK_Laag_Namen_2025.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
gouden_namenlijst <- tolower(trimws(df_namen_sleutel$Laagnaam))

area_shape_proj <- project(area_shape, crs(master_grid))
area_buffer_fix <- buffer(area_shape_proj, width = buffer_m)

id_raster_TV <- crop(master_grid, area_buffer_fix, snap = "near")
template_TV_mask <- terra::rasterize(area_buffer_fix, id_raster_TV, field = 1)

lokale_ids  <- terra::cells(template_TV_mask)
coords      <- terra::xyFromCell(template_TV_mask, lokale_ids)
globale_ids <- terra::cellFromXY(master_grid, coords)

vertaal_df <- data.table(
  lokale_id  = lokale_ids,
  globale_id = globale_ids
)[!is.na(globale_id)]

studiegebied_globale_ids <- vertaal_df$globale_id

template_TV <- terra::classify(template_TV_mask, cbind(NA, 0))
values(id_raster_TV) <- NA

grens_web <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::project(area_shape, "EPSG:4326"))

rm(template_TV_mask, lokale_ids, coords, globale_ids)
gc()
```

```{r}
df_nieuw <- read_csv(here("data/input/Excel_files/Resultaten_Totaal_Samengevoegd.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Alle unieke codes voor Grutto & Wulp verzamelen, BEHALVE akker
df_weidevogel_codes <- df_nieuw %>%
  mutate(Soort_clean = tolower(trimws(Soort))) %>%
  filter(Soort_clean %in% c("grutto", "wulp")) %>%
  mutate(Code = tolower(trimws(Code)),
         Match = tolower(trimws(Match))) %>%
  filter(Type != "akker") %>% # Akkers worden niet als biotoop meegenomen
  distinct(Code, Match)

exact_codes <- unique(df_weidevogel_codes$Code[df_weidevogel_codes$Match == "exact"])
bevat_codes <- unique(df_weidevogel_codes$Code[df_weidevogel_codes$Match == "bevat"])

tabel_vlaanderen <- readRDS(here("data/input/Raster_Vlaanderen/BWK_Tabel_Turnhouts_Vennegebied_Plus_50km.rds"))
setDT(tabel_vlaanderen)
tabel_vlaanderen[, CODE := tolower(trimws(CODE))]

if(length(bevat_codes) > 0) {
  bevat_codes_escaped <- gsub("([\\.\\^\\$\\*\\+\\?\\(\\)\\[\\{\\\\\\|])", "\\\\\\1", bevat_codes)
  bevat_codes_anchored <- paste0("^", bevat_codes_escaped)
  regex_term <- paste0(bevat_codes_anchored, collapse = "|")
  
  tabel_gefilterd <- tabel_vlaanderen[CODE %in% exact_codes | grepl(regex_term, CODE)]
} else {
  tabel_gefilterd <- tabel_vlaanderen[CODE %in% exact_codes]
}

tabel_TV <- tabel_gefilterd[cel_id %in% studiegebied_globale_ids]
tabel_TV_unique <- unique(tabel_TV, by = c("cel_id", "CODE"))

tabel_cel_som <- tabel_TV_unique[, .(Oppervlakte = pmin(sum(BWK_FRAC, na.rm = TRUE), 1.0)), by = .(cel_id)]

r_biotoop_match <- id_raster_TV * NA
r_biotoop_opp   <- id_raster_TV * NA

if(nrow(tabel_cel_som) > 0) {
  tabel_cel_som[, Oppervlakte := pmin(Oppervlakte, 1)]
  tabel_cel_som[, Match := ifelse(Oppervlakte >= 0.01, 1, 0)]
  
  setnames(tabel_cel_som, "cel_id", "globale_id")
  tabel_finaal_mapping <- merge(tabel_cel_som, vertaal_df, by = "globale_id", all.x = TRUE)
  tabel_finaal_mapping <- tabel_finaal_mapping[!is.na(lokale_id)]
  
  if(nrow(tabel_finaal_mapping) > 0) {
    tabel_matches_clean <- tabel_finaal_mapping[Match == 1]
    if(nrow(tabel_matches_clean) > 0) {
      r_biotoop_match[tabel_matches_clean$lokale_id] <- tabel_matches_clean$Match
    }
    r_biotoop_opp[tabel_finaal_mapping$lokale_id] <- tabel_finaal_mapping$Oppervlakte
  }
}

# Akkers isoleren voor de uitsluitingsfilter
tabel_akkers <- tabel_vlaanderen[grepl("^b", CODE) & cel_id %in% studiegebied_globale_ids]
tabel_akkers_som <- tabel_akkers[, .(Oppervlakte = sum(BWK_FRAC, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cel_id)]

r_akkers_max <- id_raster_TV * NA
if(nrow(tabel_akkers_som) > 0) {
  setnames(tabel_akkers_som, "cel_id", "globale_id")
  mapping_akkers <- merge(tabel_akkers_som, vertaal_df, by = "globale_id", all.x = TRUE)[!is.na(lokale_id)]
  r_akkers_max[mapping_akkers$lokale_id] <- ifelse(mapping_akkers$Oppervlakte >= 0.01, 1, 0)
}

raster_simpel_final <- id_raster_TV
rm(tabel_gefilterd, tabel_TV, tabel_TV_unique, tabel_cel_som, tabel_akkers, tabel_akkers_som)
gc()
```

```{r}
r_grb_raw <- rast(here("data/input/Raster_Vlaanderen/vlaanderen_grb_water_10m.tif"))
r_grb_crop <- terra::crop(r_grb_raw, area_buffer_fix)
r_grb_sync <- terra::resample(r_grb_crop, raster_simpel_final, method = "near")
rm(r_grb_raw, r_grb_crop)
gc()

grb_water_bin <- terra::ifel(r_grb_sync > 0, 1, NA)
temp_patchfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".tif")
water_patches <- terra::patches(grb_water_bin, directions = 8, zeroAsNA = TRUE, filename = temp_patchfile, overwrite = TRUE)
water_freq <- terra::freq(water_patches)

klein_water_ids <- water_freq$value[water_freq$count <= 50] # <= 0.5 ha
water_grb_max <- terra::ifel(water_patches %in% klein_water_ids, 1, NA)
terra::crs(water_grb_max) <- terra::crs(raster_simpel_final)

# Direct toevoegen aan de integrale biotooplaag
r_biotoop_match <- terra::cover(r_biotoop_match, water_grb_max)
r_biotoop_opp   <- terra::cover(r_biotoop_opp, terra::ifel(!is.na(water_grb_max), 0.01, NA))

rm(water_patches, water_grb_max, grb_water_bin, water_freq)
if(file.exists(temp_patchfile)) unlink(temp_patchfile)
gc()
```

```{r}
# 1. AKKERFILTER
filter_akker <- terra::ifel(!is.na(r_akkers_max) & r_akkers_max == 1, 1, NA)

# 2. BEBOUWINGSFILTER (Dorpskernen >10 ha met 100m verstoringszone)
bebouwings_lagen <- gouden_namenlijst[grepl("^u[a-z0-9]", gouden_namenlijst) | gouden_namenlijst == "u"]
bebouwings_lagen <- bebouwings_lagen[bebouwings_lagen != "ulm"]

tabel_bebouw_TV <- tabel_vlaanderen[CODE %in% bebouwings_lagen & cel_id %in% studiegebied_globale_ids]
tabel_bebouw_som <- tabel_bebouw_TV[, .(Present = ifelse(sum(BWK_FRAC, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, 1, 0)), by = .(cel_id)]

r_bebouwing_raw <- id_raster_TV * NA
if(nrow(tabel_bebouw_som) > 0) {
  setnames(tabel_bebouw_som, "cel_id", "globale_id")
  tabel_bebouw_mapping <- merge(tabel_bebouw_som, vertaal_df, by = "globale_id", all.x = TRUE)
  tabel_bebouw_mapping <- tabel_bebouw_mapping[!is.na(lokale_id) & Present == 1]
  if(nrow(tabel_bebouw_mapping) > 0) {
    r_bebouwing_raw[tabel_bebouw_mapping$lokale_id] <- 1
  }
}

r_bebouwing_schoon <- terra::ifel(!is.na(r_bebouwing_raw) & r_bebouwing_raw == 1, 1, NA)
res_bebouw_groot <- cluster_filter_compleet(
  masker     = r_bebouwing_schoon,
  opp_laag   = r_bebouwing_schoon,
  drempel_m2 = 100000, # 10 ha
  dist_m     = 100,
  werkelijk  = FALSE
)

if (!is.null(res_bebouw_groot$raster) && !terra::global(is.na(res_bebouw_groot$raster), "sum")[[1]] == terra::ncell(res_bebouw_groot$raster)) {
  buf_bebouw <- terra::buffer(res_bebouw_groot$raster, width = 100)
  masker_bebouw_100m <- terra::ifel(!is.na(buf_bebouw) & buf_bebouw > 0, 1, NA)
} else {
  masker_bebouw_100m <- id_raster_TV * NA
}

# 3. HOOGGROEN FILTER (Boskernen >20 are met 50m verstoringszone)
hooggroen_raw <- rast(here("data/input/ASCI Files/Groenkaart_2021.tif"))
area_buffer_groen_crs <- project(area_buffer_fix, crs(hooggroen_raw))
hooggroen_local_raw <- crop(hooggroen_raw, area_buffer_groen_crs)

hooggroen_binair  <- terra::classify(hooggroen_local_raw, matrix(c(0.5, 1.5, 1), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), others = 0)
hooggroen_10m_raw <- terra::aggregate(hooggroen_binair, fact = 10, fun = "max")
hooggroen_sync    <- project(hooggroen_10m_raw, crs(raster_simpel_final)) %>% terra::resample(raster_simpel_final, method = "near")

r_groen_bin <- terra::ifel(!is.na(hooggroen_sync) & hooggroen_sync > 0, 1, NA)
w_matrix <- matrix(1, nrow = 5, ncol = 5)
temp_groen_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".tif")
groen_som <- terra::focal(r_groen_bin, w = w_matrix, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE, filename = temp_groen_file, overwrite = TRUE)

r_groen_20are <- terra::ifel(groen_som >= 12 & r_groen_bin == 1, 1, NA)
buf_groen <- terra::buffer(r_groen_20are, width = 50)
masker_groen_50m <- terra::ifel(!is.na(buf_groen) & buf_groen > 0, 1, NA)

# 4. PAS ALLE FILTERS TOE OP HET INTEGRALE BIOTOOP
weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_max <- terra::mask(r_biotoop_match, filter_akker, inverse = TRUE) %>%
                                 terra::mask(masker_bebouw_100m, inverse = TRUE) %>%
                                 terra::mask(masker_groen_50m, inverse = TRUE)

weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_opp <- terra::mask(r_biotoop_opp, filter_akker, inverse = TRUE) %>%
                                 terra::mask(masker_bebouw_100m, inverse = TRUE) %>%
                                 terra::mask(masker_groen_50m, inverse = TRUE)

rm(hooggroen_raw, hooggroen_local_raw, hooggroen_binair, hooggroen_10m_raw, r_groen_bin, groen_som, tabel_vlaanderen)
gc()
```

```{r}
drempel_netwerk_m2 <- totaal_netwerk_ha * 10000

# Spoor A: Maximaal Potentieel
res_netwerk_max <- cluster_filter_compleet(
  masker     = weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_max,
  opp_laag   = weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_max,
  drempel_m2 = drempel_netwerk_m2,
  dist_m     = koppel_afstand_m, # 200m koppeling via 100m buffer
  werkelijk  = FALSE
)
weidevogel_finaal_max <- res_netwerk_max$raster

# Spoor B: Werkelijke Oppervlakte
r_binair_opp <- terra::ifel(!is.na(weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_opp) & weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_opp > 0, 1, NA)
res_netwerk_opp <- cluster_filter_compleet(
  masker     = r_binair_opp,
  opp_laag   = weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_opp,
  drempel_m2 = drempel_netwerk_m2,
  dist_m     = koppel_afstand_m,
  werkelijk  = TRUE
)
weidevogel_finaal_opp <- terra::mask(weidevogel_biotoop_schoon_opp, res_netwerk_opp$raster)

gc()
```

```{r}
get_classified_netwerk_stats <- function(r_finaal) {
  if (is.null(r_finaal) || all(is.na(terra::values(r_finaal, mat=FALSE)))) {
    return(list(n_binnen = 0, n_buiten = 0, ha_binnen = 0, ha_buiten = 0))
  }
  
  r_buf <- terra::buffer(r_finaal, width = koppel_afstand_m / 2)
  cl_wolken <- terra::patches(r_buf, directions = 8, zeroAsNA = TRUE)
  r_net_ids <- terra::mask(cl_wolken, r_finaal)
  
  p_grens_sync <- terra::project(area_shape, terra::crs(r_finaal))
  r_grens_tv   <- terra::rasterize(p_grens_sync, r_finaal, field = 1, background = NA)
  
  r_net_binnen_tv <- terra::mask(r_net_ids, r_grens_tv)
  ids_binnen <- unique(na.omit(terra::values(r_net_binnen_tv, mat = FALSE)))
  ids_alle   <- unique(na.omit(terra::values(r_net_ids, mat = FALSE)))
  ids_buiten <- setdiff(ids_alle, ids_binnen)
  
  ha_binnen <- if (length(ids_binnen) > 0) calc_ha_exact(terra::mask(r_finaal, terra::ifel(r_net_ids %in% ids_binnen, 1, NA))) else 0
  ha_buiten <- if (length(ids_buiten) > 0) calc_ha_exact(terra::mask(r_finaal, terra::ifel(r_net_ids %in% ids_buiten, 1, NA))) else 0
  
  return(list(n_binnen = length(ids_binnen), n_buiten = length(ids_buiten), ha_binnen = ha_binnen, ha_buiten = ha_buiten))
}

stats_max <- get_classified_netwerk_stats(weidevogel_finaal_max)
stats_opp <- get_classified_netwerk_stats(weidevogel_finaal_opp)

weidevogel_audit_tabel <- data.frame(
  Type = c("Maximaal Potentieel ((Deels) Binnen TV Gebied)", 
           "Maximaal Potentieel (Volledig Buiten TV Gebied)", 
           "Werkelijk Habitat ((Deels) Binnen TV Gebied)", 
           "Werkelijk Habitat (Volledig Buiten TV Gebied)"),
  Netwerken = c(stats_max$n_binnen, stats_max$n_buiten, stats_opp$n_binnen, stats_opp$n_buiten),
  Oppervlakte_ha = c(round(stats_max$ha_binnen, 2), round(stats_max$ha_buiten, 2), round(stats_opp$ha_binnen, 2), round(stats_opp$ha_buiten, 2))
)

weidevogel_audit_tabel %>% 
  knitr::kable(caption = "Potentieel leefgebied Weidevogel (Integraal model)") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r}
# Voorbereiden van polygonen op basis van werkelijk leefgebied (Spoor B)
if (!is.null(weidevogel_finaal_opp) && !all(is.na(terra::values(weidevogel_finaal_opp, mat=FALSE)))) {
  
  # Netwerkwolken bepalen op basis van de koppelafstand
  r_buf_opp <- terra::buffer(weidevogel_finaal_opp, width = koppel_afstand_m / 2)
  p_net_wolken <- terra::patches(r_buf_opp, directions = 8, zeroAsNA = TRUE) %>% 
                  terra::as.polygons(aggregate = TRUE) %>% 
                  sf::st_as_sf()
  
  colnames(p_net_wolken)[1] <- "Netwerk_ID"
  
  # Vectoriseer het werkelijke habitat
  poly_finaal <- terra::as.polygons(weidevogel_finaal_opp > 0, aggregate = TRUE) %>% 
    sf::st_as_sf() %>% 
    sf::st_transform(4326)
  
  # Koppel Netwerk_IDs en bereken netto hectares per cluster via zonal
  cl_ids_rast <- terra::patches(r_buf_opp, directions = 8, zeroAsNA = TRUE)
  cl_ids_biotoop <- terra::mask(cl_ids_rast, weidevogel_finaal_opp)
  
  stats_ha <- terra::zonal(weidevogel_finaal_opp, cl_ids_biotoop, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
  colnames(stats_ha) <- c("Netwerk_ID", "Netto_ha")
  
  poly_finaal <- sf::st_join(poly_finaal, sf::st_transform(p_net_wolken, 4326), join = sf::st_intersects) %>%
    left_join(stats_ha, by = "Netwerk_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Popup = paste0(
        "<div style='font-family: Arial; min-width: 180px;'>",
        "<strong>Potentieel Weidevogelhabitat</strong><br><hr>",
        "<strong>Netwerk ID:</strong> #", Netwerk_ID, "<br>",
        "<strong>Netto Oppervlakte:</strong> ", round(Netto_ha, 2), " ha",
        "</div>"
      )
    )
} else {
  poly_finaal <- NULL
}

# Transformeer rasters naar Web Mercator voor weergave
r_web_max <- if(!is.null(weidevogel_finaal_max)) terra::project(weidevogel_finaal_max, "EPSG:4326", method = "near") else NULL
r_web_opp <- if(!is.null(weidevogel_finaal_opp)) terra::project(weidevogel_finaal_opp, "EPSG:4326", method = "near") else NULL

# Maak Leaflet Kaart
m <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles(group = "OSM (Standaardkaart)") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satelliet (Luchtfoto)")

if(!is.null(r_web_max)) {
  m <- m %>% addRasterImage(r_web_max, colors = "#F39C12", opacity = 0.4, group = "Maximaal Potentieel (Raster)")
}

if(!is.null(r_web_opp)) {
  m <- m %>% addRasterImage(r_web_opp, colors = "#27AE60", opacity = 0.6, group = "Werkelijk Habitat (Raster)")
}

if(!is.null(poly_finaal) && nrow(poly_finaal) > 0) {
  m <- m %>% addPolygons(
    data = poly_finaal,
    fillColor = "#27AE60",
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    color = "#1E8449",
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = ~Popup,
    label = ~paste0("Netwerk #", Netwerk_ID, ": ", round(Netto_ha, 2), " ha"),
    group = "Geselecteerde Netwerken (Vector)"
  )
}

m <- m %>%
  addPolygons(data = grens_web, fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5, group = "Grens Studiegebied") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("OSM (Standaardkaart)", "Satelliet (Luchtfoto)"),
    overlayGroups = c("Geselecteerde Netwerken (Vector)", "Werkelijk Habitat (Raster)", "Maximaal Potentieel (Raster)", "Grens Studiegebied"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

m
```

```{r}
base_dir <- here("data/output/Turnhouts_Vennegebied/Rasters_Soorten")
folders <- list(
  potentie  = file.path(base_dir, "01_Maximale_Potentie"),
  werkelijk = file.path(base_dir, "02_Werkelijke_Oppervlakte")
)

purrr::walk(folders, ~if (!dir.exists(.x)) dir.create(.x, recursive = TRUE))

potentie_export_rast  <- if(exists("weidevogel_finaal_max") && !is.null(weidevogel_finaal_max)) terra::ifel(!is.na(weidevogel_finaal_max), 1, NA) else terra::rast(template_TV, vals = NA)
werkelijk_export_rast <- if(exists("weidevogel_finaal_opp") && !is.null(weidevogel_finaal_opp)) terra::ifel(!is.na(weidevogel_finaal_opp) & weidevogel_finaal_opp > 0, 1, NA) else terra::rast(template_TV, vals = NA)

export_config <- list(
  list(rast = potentie_export_rast,  naam = "Maximale_Potentie",     folder = folders$potentie,  type = "INT1U"),
  list(rast = werkelijk_export_rast, naam = "Werkelijke_Oppervlaktes", folder = folders$werkelijk, type = "INT1U")
)

for(item in export_config) {
  file_path <- file.path(item$folder, paste0("Habitat_", item$naam, "_", soort, ".tif"))
  export_rast <- terra::deepcopy(item$rast)
  export_rast <- terra::extend(export_rast, master_grid, fill = NA)
  
  writeRaster(export_rast, filename = file_path, overwrite = TRUE, gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW"), datatype = item$type)
  message(paste("   [OK] Geëxporteerd:", basename(file_path)))
}

gc()
message("✓ Weidevogel-kaarten (Potentieel leefgebied) succesvol geëxporteerd!")
```
